topic: Getting started: ask the AI to ask you questions first, answer by voice, then have it flag what to double-check
pillar: Getting started with AI (where to find it, how to ask, the AI already on your phone)
caption:
Staring at the AI chat box with no idea what to type? 🤔

Try this: tell it what you need help with, then ask it to ask YOU a few questions first.
It asks one question at a time, and you can tap the microphone and answer out loud.
When it's done, ask it to list what it assumed so you know what to double-check.
As always, keep account numbers, passwords and ID numbers out of the chat. 🔒

Save this post so the prompt is ready when you need it 📌
The free guide, 10 AI Shortcuts, is waiting for you at the link in my bio.

slides.title: Don't know what to ask AI? Let it ask you
slides.subtitle: One line that makes answers fit your life

slides.title: Not sure what to type? That's normal.
slides.body: Many people freeze at the empty chat box. A simple fix: say what you want help with, then ask the AI to ask you a few questions before it answers.

slides.title: The ask-me-first prompt
slides.body: Works in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Meta AI. Fill in the brackets with your own task.
slides.prompt: I want help with [what you need, for example planning my parents' holiday visit]. Before you answer, ask me up to 5 questions, one at a time, so you understand my situation. Then give me your suggestion in plain English.

slides.title: Tap the microphone and just talk
slides.body: In ChatGPT, tap the microphone icon next to the typing box and speak your answer. Short answers are fine. Saying I'm not sure is a fine answer too.

slides.title: Example: a birthday card for your sister
slides.body: Asked plainly, the AI writes a card that could suit anyone. Asked to question you first, it learns her age, a shared memory and your tone. The card sounds like the two of you.

slides.title: Ask it what to double-check
slides.body: Paste this once it gives you its answer. It shows you any guesses it made along the way.
slides.prompt: Thank you. Now list anything you assumed about my situation, and anything I should double-check before I use this.

slides.title: Keep private details out of the chat
slides.body: Answer its questions in general terms. Leave out account numbers, passwords and ID numbers. Saying my bank or my mum's doctor gives it plenty to work with.

slides.title: Save this for the next time you get stuck
slides.body: Want more simple tricks like this one? Grab the free guide, 10 AI Shortcuts, from the link in my bio.
